data: Amazon (AMZN) delivered top-line growth in fiscal 2022 but saw a sharp reversal in profitability. Revenue rose 9.4% to $514.0 billion in fiscal 2022 from $469.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Net income swung to a loss of $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022 against a profit of $33.4 billion in fiscal 2021, a net income decline of 108.2%. Cash generation was more resilient: operating cash flow was $46.8 billion in fiscal 2022, close to the $46.3 billion recorded in fiscal 2021. Cash and cash equivalents increased to $53.9 billion at fiscal 2022 year-end from $36.2 billion in fiscal 2021. Total assets grew to $462.7 billion in fiscal 2022 from $420.5 billion, while total liabilities rose to $316.6 billion from $282.3 billion. We see the stable operating cash flow and higher cash balance as an offset to the fiscal 2022 earnings loss.
